covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the regular U.S. market close on Thursday, October 1, 2026, plus companies reporting before the next U.S. market open on Friday, October 2, 2026.
market_context_summary: Treasury yields were near 24-year highs, pressuring equities, while Friday's U.S. jobs report creates a macro catalyst at the next open. The qualified earnings universe contains only Nike.

ranked_companies.timing: After market close on Thursday, October 1, 2026; release expected at approximately 4:15 p.m. ET and call at 5:00 p.m. ET.
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Fiscal Q2 EPS outlook versus the approximately $0.53 Street expectation.
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: A low bar, deep share-price reset, and moderate short interest could produce a relief rally.
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Deteriorating global channel checks and negative fiscal-2027 estimate revisions make a downside reaction more likely, but the deeply de-rated shares leave high relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Visible Alpha and LSEG-based previews cluster near $11.3-$11.4 billion of revenue and $0.44 of EPS; Greater China, Direct, gross margin, and fiscal Q2 commentary are the key underpinnings.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: A revenue beat, slight gross-margin expansion, steadier North America wholesale sell-through, and a fiscal Q2 EPS outlook near or above $0.53 could trigger a sharp relief rally.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A sales miss, continued Direct and China weakness, elevated promotions, or a fiscal Q2 EPS outlook in the low-$0.40s or below would validate the delayed-turnaround thesis.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Near-dated options implied roughly an 8.7%-8.8% move; short interest was about 5.8% of float, and the shares were down roughly 44% year to date, increasing squeeze and relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: UBS cut its target and expected a five-cent fiscal Q1 EPS miss plus fiscal Q2 EPS of $0.31-$0.43 versus $0.53 consensus; BofA downgraded Nike to Underperform, cut its target to $30, and set fiscal-2027 EPS 14% below consensus.

key_sources.title: Nike official fiscal Q1 2027 earnings announcement

ranked_companies.pass_agreement: All three independent passes produced Lean Down calls; direction scores ranged from -50 to -30 and reversal-risk values from 64 to 74.

excluded_high_reversal_or_weak_names.reason: The absolute consensus direction score exceeds 30, but reversal risk of 68 is above the 40 maximum; the hypothetical basket is therefore 0% allocated and 100% unallocated.

research_allocation_view.plain_statement: This is a research prioritization model, not financial advice.

detailed_company_sections.consensus_summary_across_passes: Passes A, B, and C independently agreed that the fiscal Q2 earnings outlook and global sales trajectory outweigh the possibility of a routine fiscal Q1 EPS beat. All three called Lean Down, with low overall disparity.
detailed_company_sections.pass_agreement_pattern: Unanimous Lean Down; the main difference was how heavily to weight the low bar and relief-rally setup.
detailed_company_sections.one_sentence_thesis: Deteriorating global channel checks and negative fiscal-2027 estimate revisions make a downside reaction more likely, but the deeply de-rated shares leave high relief-rally risk.
detailed_company_sections.what_the_market_expects: Approximately $0.44 EPS on $11.3-$11.4 billion of revenue, with revenue down about 3% year over year, Direct down about 4%, and Greater China down roughly 13%.
detailed_company_sections.what_could_make_the_stock_go_up: A clean revenue beat, slight gross-margin expansion, better North America wholesale sell-through, and fiscal Q2 EPS commentary near or above $0.53.
detailed_company_sections.what_could_make_the_stock_go_down: A revenue miss, persistent Direct and China weakness, elevated promotions, or fiscal Q2 EPS guidance in the low-$0.40s or below.
detailed_company_sections.reversal_risk_assessment: High. The stock has already lost roughly 44% year to date, short interest is moderate rather than extreme but rising, and a less-bad guide could force a relief rally even if reported-quarter trends remain weak.
detailed_company_sections.social_consumer_sentiment_read: Recent retail-investor discussion was bearish and frustrated, with a smaller contrarian-value cohort focused on the 12- to 13-year-low share price and insider purchases. The sample was noisy and received minimal scoring weight.
detailed_company_sections.options_positioning_read: Near-dated options implied roughly an 8.7%-8.8% move, close to Nike's recent earnings-move history. The setup does not imply a clear directional edge and warns that even the correct direction may not exceed the priced move.
detailed_company_sections.analyst_estimate_revision_read: The revision pulse was negative: UBS modeled a fiscal Q1 miss and fiscal Q2 EPS below consensus, while BofA downgraded the stock and moved its fiscal-2027 EPS estimate 14% below consensus.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: Fiscal Q1 lands near consensus, but management's fiscal Q2 outlook confirms a slower recovery, producing a modest post-earnings decline.
detailed_company_sections.bull_case: The low bar is cleared, gross margin improves slightly, North America wholesale offsets Direct weakness, and guidance triggers an 8%-plus relief move.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Sales and margins miss together, management resets fiscal Q2 or fiscal-2027 expectations lower, and the stock retests or breaks its recent lows.
detailed_company_sections.final_directional_judgment: Lean Down, with the likely move judged less certain than the bearish fundamental setup because the bad-news bar is already low.
detailed_company_sections.research_allocation_priority: Not prioritized. Reversal risk of 68 fails the maximum-40 allocation rule, so the basket remains 100% unallocated.
detailed_company_sections.disparity_effect_on_conviction: Low disparity supports the directional read, but it does not override the high reversal-risk exclusion.
detailed_company_sections.method_update_note: None. Existing low-bar, forward-look, and timing-confirmation guardrails were applied without adding a new method rule.

disclaimer_text: This is research, not financial advice. Earnings reactions are highly uncertain and can be driven by market positioning, guidance, macro conditions, and management commentary rather than reported results alone.
